gloss: to be put in order, to be settled

definitions.gloss: to be put in order, to be tidied up
to be settled, to be resolved
definitions.explanation: For a matter to be concluded.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}が{片付|かたづ}いた。
{問題|もんだい}が{片付|かたづ}いた。
{仕事|しごと}が{片付|かたづ}いたら{連絡|れんらく}する。
examples.english: I'll contact you when work is done.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}が{片付|かたづ}いた。
examples.english: The luggage has been put away.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{準備|じゅんび}がやっと{片付|かたづ}いた。
examples.english: The moving preparations are finally taken care of.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{手続|てつづ}きが{片付|かたづ}いて、ほっとした。
examples.english: I was relieved that the paperwork was settled.

notes:
{片付|かたづ}く is an intransitive godan verb meaning for things to become organized or for matters to be resolved.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {片付|かたづ}ける (transitive — to tidy up, to settle)

ASPECT (ている):
{片付|かたづ}いている means "is tidy" or "is settled" — the resulting state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {部屋|へや}が{片付|かたづ}く: the room gets cleaned up
- {問題|もんだい}が{片付|かたづ}く: the problem gets resolved
- {用事|ようじ}が{片付|かたづ}く: tasks get done
- {仕事|しごと}が{片付|かたづ}く: work gets finished
- {荷物|にもつ}が{片付|かたづ}く: luggage/belongings get put away

NOTE:
Covers both physical tidying ({部屋|へや}が{片付|かたづ}く) and abstract resolution ({問題|もんだい}が{片付|かたづ}く). The transitive {片付|かたづ}ける is more frequently used in everyday speech.
